what_to_do: Check prices on WOs and parts.
expected_result: Visible. Parts Manager has See Financial Data ON.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Parts Manager role has the 'See Financial Data' cross-toggle ON, so dollar figures (line rates/totals, part costs and sell prices, work-order finance totals) should be visible everywhere. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Parts Manager row #43]
expected_plain: Logged in as a Parts Manager, prices and dollar amounts on work orders and parts should be shown, not hidden.
actual_result_plain: Opened work order S9-24163 as Tech-with-Parts-Manager-role. Dollar figures are fully visible across the lines and parts: sample amounts on the page included $24.39, $1,045.95, $109.82, $1,180.16, $1,239.16, $232.43, $116.22. Total/Labor/Parts/Rate columns and finance wording are present. fe-permissions confirm cross_toggles.seeFinancialData=true and view_mode=full, and the parts data returned by the API includes cost and sell_price fields with real numbers.
notes: seeFinancialData=true confirmed in fe-permissions. Prices render on the WO lines/parts view. (WO also shows an 'Over Limit' badge which per policy blocks nothing.)
